purpose: Test whether a raw-arrival persistence classifier repairs V144's path-dependent expert routing error: start from exact native Greedy, retain Greedy after a short first shock, switch to exact native FaaSRank only after sustained excess arrivals remain observable, and switch to exact native LoadLeast after a recurrent shock; admit Nash only under the unchanged complete service-and-welfare certificate.

observed_training_diagnosis.v144_gate_result: V144 passed only the two spike QPR gates. Spike throughput mean exceeded Greedy by 63.3 percent but was positive against Greedy on only one of three seeds; sustained throughput trailed FaaSRank by 7.5 percent; pulse throughput and QPR trailed LoadLeast by 19.2 and 26.6 percent.
observed_training_diagnosis.path_dependence: The V144 final assignment matched the scenario's strongest native expert in only 16-22 percent of spike player windows, 84-87 percent of sustained player windows, and 83-89 percent of pulse player windows. The remaining early divergent windows were sufficient to change the full-run outcome.
observed_training_diagnosis.detector_failure: The latched rolling detector marked every 50 ms spike and pulse first episode as sustained at age 50, after the underlying high-arrival interval had already ended, and retained FaaSRank thereafter.
observed_training_diagnosis.nash_activity: Accepted Nash replacements were sparse (0-97 per 1,080-3,197 player windows) and do not explain the dominant routing error.
observed_training_diagnosis.input_only_qualification: On the nine frozen input tapes, at first-episode age 55 the ratio of the most recent five raw first-seen-arrival frames to the frozen preceding-80-frame baseline was 0.825-0.889 for spike, 0.859-0.966 for pulse, and 2.541-2.587 for sustained. The preregistered 3/2 threshold separates all nine without outcome or future input. This qualification uses input tapes only and cannot support a performance claim.

hypotheses.primary: A causal raw-arrival persistence check can distinguish a completed 50 ms shock from a continuing 200 ms shock, avoiding V144's rolling-latch misclassification without reading scenario labels or future arrivals.
hypotheses.secondary: Greedy is a safer pre-identification initializer than Hash; after causal identification, exact FaaSRank for sustained overload and exact LoadLeast after recurrence can preserve the strongest native trajectories while a strictly guarded Nash proposal supplies only certified improvements.
hypotheses.falsification: The sole V145 arm is falsified if it fails any of the same nine strict scenario-by-metric gates on the complete E1526-E1528 adaptive-training cohort.

allowed_at_runtime: current simulator state, common-HPA placement candidates, containers, queues, node resources, configured bandwidth, and immutable function and DAG configuration
first-seen request identities and their causal per-frame arrival counts through the current scheduling window
the existing rolling 3/2 arrival-shock detector only for false-to-true episode onset
a frozen preceding-80-frame raw-arrival baseline at the first episode onset and the most recent five raw arrival counts at first-episode age 55
exact persistent native Greedy, FaaSRank, and LoadLeast command streams evaluated from the same pre-dispatch state
current admitted immutable work, same-window projected immutable work, cold start, configured parent transfer, and immutable-baseline paper welfare
forbidden_at_runtime: scenario or burst label, registered burst intervals, seed identity, future arrivals, or future state
completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, completed-request aggregates, or outcome feedback
V142-V144 numeric performance values as a direct runtime lookup, fitted coefficient, seed-conditioned route, or post-reveal route edit
information_boundary.adaptive_training_disclosure: V142-V144 training outcomes and the input-only detector qualification were consulted to formulate V145. E1526-E1528 are deliberately reused as an in-sample adaptive development cohort; they can never support a V145 paper claim.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any arrival-history discontinuity, expert lifecycle mismatch, command-stream mismatch, incomplete or infeasible selected assignment, unavailable or nonfinite service/welfare certificate, provenance mismatch, or failed blind audit rejects reveal. Arrival-history discontinuity selects Greedy and marks the run ineligible for reveal.

causal_persistence_contract.episode_onset: Use the existing rolling first-seen-arrival detector only for a false-to-true episode transition; its 3/2 comparison and 50-frame latch remain unchanged.
causal_persistence_contract.quiet_and_unclassified: Select exact native Greedy before the first episode and through first-episode age 54.
causal_persistence_contract.baseline_freeze: At the first episode onset, freeze the sum of raw first-seen arrivals over the preceding 80 consecutive frames. Missing history, fewer than 20 baseline arrivals, overflow, or a frame discontinuity fails closed.
causal_persistence_contract.persistence_test: Exactly at first-episode age 55, sum the most recent five raw first-seen-arrival frames. Classify the first episode as sustained iff recent5/5 is at least 3/2 of baseline80/80, evaluated by checked integer cross multiplication. The classification is performed once and retained.
causal_persistence_contract.short_first_episode: If the persistence test is false, retain exact native Greedy unless recurrence is observed.
causal_persistence_contract.sustained_first_episode: If the persistence test is true, select exact native FaaSRank and retain it unless recurrence is observed.
causal_persistence_contract.recurrent_episode: At the start of the second or any later rolling-detector episode, select exact native LoadLeast and retain it for the rest of the run.
causal_persistence_contract.expert_lifecycle: Each of the three native shadow experts is initialized exactly once and advanced exactly once per scheduling window, including windows in which it is not selected.
causal_persistence_contract.dispatch: Dispatch exactly the selected expert's complete feasible native command sequence projected to the common parent-complete feasible cohort. No union, tail fill, extra player, scenario condition, or candidate-score selector is allowed.
causal_persistence_contract.nash_acceptance: Relative to the exact selected native assignment and identical player cohort: complete proposal, service maximum nonworse, service sum strictly lower, and immutable-baseline paper welfare nonworse.
causal_persistence_contract.regression: Fixtures must cover quiet Greedy, exact onset, age 54, short classification at age 55, sustained classification at age 55, recurrence, frame reset/discontinuity, three persistent expert lifecycles, exact command equality, checked arithmetic, and rejection of future/scenario/outcome input.

treatment.native_selection: quiet/unclassified Greedy; age-55 raw sustained FaaSRank; second episode LoadLeast
treatment.nash_acceptance: same selected native cohort and command count; complete proposal; service maximum nonworse; service sum strictly lower; paper welfare nonworse

training_design.independent_unit: one frozen V142 workload tape and environment seed
training_design.candidate_run_order_rule: Use one seeded permutation of the nine frozen scenario-by-seed candidate cells; never reorder after any result or failure.

selection_rule.per_scenario_per_metric: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the maximum frozen concurrent V142 baseline mean and candidate-minus-each-baseline is strictly positive on at least two of three paired seeds
selection_rule.zero_completion: retain every run; finite-only QPR is unavailable and zero-completed-as-zero is zero; no imputation or seed replacement
selection_rule.confirmation: Training authorizes no paper or operational claim. A pass may only authorize a separately preregistered untouched E1497-E1516 confirmation cohort; failure retires V145 without seed replacement.

logging_and_blind_audit.per_window: Log raw current first-seen count, frozen baseline80, recent5, checked persistence comparison, one-time classification state, rolling episode transitions, all three shadow invocations and command hashes, selected expert/reason, exact dispatch equality, Nash guard evidence, and existing solver/reference observations.
logging_and_blind_audit.blind_audit: Before reveal validate the exact nine-run product, attempt-1 QC, zero quarantine, ledger, runtime consensus, pairings to the 81 frozen V142 baselines, exact reuse hashes, 12 tapes, nine new references, exact arrival-only state transitions and age-55 persistence arithmetic, every expert lifecycle and command equality, selected cohort/dispatch, Nash certificate, and zero parsed candidate performance summaries.
